bagPolicy.summary: Small purses and single-pocket drawstring bags are allowed and may be searched. Large multi-pocket backpacks or bags bigger than 14 x 11 x 5 inches are not allowed.
prohibited: Multi-pocket backpacks or bags larger than 14 x 11 x 5 inches
bagPolicy.quote: Large Multi-Pocket Backpacks/Bags (larger than 14” x 11” x 5”)

parking.summary: Metered street parking is generally available nearby. The closest garages are Fulton Garage at 901 Convention Center Blvd and The Riverwalk at 500 Port of New Orleans Pl, each about 2 blocks away.
parking.quote: Fulton Garage: 901 Convention Center Blvd. (2 blocks, rates vary)

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Republic NOLA. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Outside food and drinks of any kind are not allowed, but empty water bottles and empty Camelbak-style water backpacks are. There is an ATM just inside the main entrance.
concessions.quote: Yes, there is an ATM located just inside our main entrance.

accessibility.summary: The first floor is ADA accessible, but the Mezzanine can only be reached by stairs. If you need special accommodations, contact the venue ahead of time at 504.528.8282.
accessibility.quote: Our first floor is ADA accessible.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is allowed for all shows through the main entrance.
reEntry.quote: Yes, re-entry is allowed for all shows via the main entrance.

ticketPickup.summary: The Box Office is open Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m., and again 1 hour before doors for every ticketed show. Tickets are sold through Eventbrite and can be scanned from your phone. Republic is always 18+ and some shows are 21+, so bring photo ID; guest list holders check in at the Box Office with ID first.
ticketPickup.quote: Our Box Office is open Mon-Fri between 11a-5p, and then 1 hour prior to the door time for all ticketed shows.

gates.summary: General admission lines up on the right at the main entrance, and VIP ticket holders use the line on the left labeled VIP. Bottle service guests check in with the Security Host at the main entrance, and door times are listed on each show's ticket page.
gates.quote: look for the line on the left labeled VIP and enter there to avoid waiting in the General Admission line on the right.
